primary_metric: mean accuracy across clean and 8 fixed corruption conditions
prior_art_status: Related weighted/noise-aware PCA and image data augmentation are established; exact proposal appears to combine known components. External novelty not established.
limitations: The prescribed inverse-variance multiplication is canceled by following per-feature StandardScaler (empirically identical predictions to uniform control).
No-standardization ablation is a different pipeline and does not validate the originally specified candidate.
Only three fixed stratified splits and synthetic pixel corruptions; exploratory pilot, not significance evidence.
Runtime recorded as whole-run wall time (validation 20.52 s; final 22.11 s); training and inference were not separately instrumented.
All runs used one CPU thread; warning output during PCA projection was retained in run logs, with results still produced.
